Public domain: every person whose words are in this text died in 1925 or earlier, so the term has ended under the law of every country, whichever one first published it.

People: Karl Ludwig Pöllnitz (author, Wikidata Q92292), died 1775. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Pöllnitz, Karl Ludwig, Freiherr von, 1692-1775") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: The memoirs of Charles-Lewis, baron de Pollnitz : Being the observations he made in his late travels from Prussia thro' Germany, Italy, France, Flanders, Holland, England, &c. ... In letters to his friend : Discovering not only the present state of the chief cities and towns; but the characters of the principal persons at the several courts .., London : Printed for D. Browne [etc.], 1737-1739 [v. 1, 1739], the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/memoirsofcharles04poll. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 69%, 46%, 70% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Karl Ludwig Pöllnitz, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
